title: Ponerse + Adjective for Involuntary Emotional and Physical Changes

sections.content:
You know *ponerse* + adjective from B1 Unit 25 (*Mi amiga se puso muy triste*). Here you use it for changes that are sudden, involuntary and usually temporary:

• **Emotions**: *Se puso rojo de vergüenza.* (He turned red with embarrassment.) *Me pongo nervioso al hablar en público.* (I get nervous speaking in public.)
• **Health**: *Se puso enfermo.* (He got sick.) *La sopa se puso fría.* (The soup got cold.)
• **Appearance**: *Se puso pálido al ver el fantasma.* (He turned pale on seeing the ghost.)

items.spanish: Siempre me pongo nervioso antes de una entrevista de trabajo.
items.english: I always get nervous before a job interview.

items.spanish: Cuando escuchó el cumplido, se puso completamente roja.
items.english: When she heard the compliment, she turned completely red.

items.spanish: El niño se puso enfermo durante el fin de semana.
items.english: The child got sick during the weekend.

sections.content: *Ponerse* is temporary and reversible: you get nervous, but then calm down again.
